However, when a charismatic young man and his band of rebels attack the Fire Nation camp and rescue them, they learn that they are trying to resist the Fire Nation’s motives to expand their territory.  Katara and Aang really enjoy their time with the band of rebels, but Sokka soon discovers that they aren’t as noble as meets the eye.

programs.title: The Great Divide
programs.description: While on their way to the North Pole, Aang and his friends arrive at a giant canyon where two groups of refugees are bickering over who should get to go across.  Aang decides to walk across with the two groups to ensure they don’t fight one another.  However, he soon learns that the two tribes have been feuding for one hundred years and they both believe their actions are justified.  But when the predators inside the canyon start to come out, Aang is stuck trying to defend both tribes from each other and the vicious wildlife.

programs.title: The Storm
programs.description: Sokka accepts a job for a fisherman who is looking for someone to help him out with his fishing. After the fisherman finds out Aang is the Avatar, Aang runs away in response to the fisherman's hostile reaction. When Katara finds Aang, he begins to reveal his life before he was frozen in the iceberg. Meanwhile, after Zuko gets into a fight with his crew, Iroh tells them about Zuko's complicated past, attempting to make both sides understand each other.

programs.title: The Blue Spirit
programs.description: While Aang, Katara and Sokka are traveling, Sokka gets a fever. Katara and Aang try to help Sokka, when Katara also catches the fever. It's up to Aang to go up on his own to save his two friends. But before he can get the medicine he is captured by the newly promoted Admiral Zhao and put in Zhao's fortress.

programs.title: The Fortuneteller
programs.description: When the group tries to help a man who is being attacked by a platypus-bear, they discover that the local town has a fortuneteller named Aunt Wu in it, who has been forecasting the town's fate for years. But when Sokka and Aang discover one of the fortuneteller's most vital predictions is dead wrong, they have to develop a plan to convince the stubborn townspeople that their beloved Aunt Wu was wrong.

programs.title: Bato of the Water Tribe
programs.description: Aang feels neglected as Katara and Sokka reunite with Bato, an old friend of their father’s from the South Pole. They begin to reminisce on their times in the past while they wait for a message to arrive from their father. Aang believes Katara and Sokka will abandon him and go out to find their father should the message arrive. However, when the messenger gives Aang the message to give to Bato, Aang betrays his friends in a way Katara or Sokka could never imagine. However, when Zuko recruits a bounty hunter named June to track Aang down, his friendship is put to the test as he must deal with the fact that he betrayed his friends while defending himself from yet another fight.

programs.title: The Deserter
programs.description: Aang and his friends go to a Fire Nation town so that Aang can witness some firebending, but their plan soon goes awry when it’s discovered that he is the Avatar. Fortunately, he's rescued by an individual who serves a firebending master named Jeong Jeong who has abandoned the Fire Nation, so Aang decides to use this time to attempt to learn firebending. The firebending master, however, seems reluctant to teach Aang.

programs.title: The Northern Air Temple
programs.description: When Aang and his friends hear rumors about surviving airbenders, they decide to stop by the Northern Air Temple on their way to the North Pole to see for themselves. What they find is a bunch of people who are not airbenders, but have mastered the art of gliding; though this upsets Aang because they have been defacing the temple. However, there was one part of the temple where nobody has been able to enter, and what Aang and his friends discover inside spells oncoming conflict.

programs.title: The Waterbending Master
programs.description: When Aang tries to find the north pole, he is found by the north pole instead. As they are taken there, Aang and Katara are eager to find a waterbending master, only to discover that girls are not allowed to learn waterbending.

programs.title: The Siege of the North (1)
programs.description: Zhao begins to launch his attack against the Northern Water Tribe. As the walls of the prestiged city begin to fall, the Avatar taps into the spirit world and seeks the help of one of the oldest spirits, in hopes of saving one of the most prominent areas of the world.

programs.title: The Siege of the North (2)
programs.description: Aang returns from the spirit world to a big surprise. Meanwhile, Zhao and his forces continue to press deeper into the Northern Water Tribe. Iroh makes a powerful stand and Zuko struggles to keep his plan intact.

programs.title: The Avatar State
programs.description: Plagued with nightmares featuring the devastating power of his Avatar State, Aang and the gang meet an Earth Kingdom general who has big plans for defeating the Fire Nation. Meanwhile, Zuko and Iroh, having survived the failed attack on the North Water Tribe, have a surprise visit from Zuko's sister with seemingly good news.

programs.title: The Cave of Two Lovers
programs.description: On their way to Omashu, Aang, Katara, and Sokka meet a group of nomads who show them a shortcut through the "Cave of Two Lovers". But when the group becomes trapped in the cave, it's up to Aang and Katara to save the group by trusting in love, possibly questioning their relationship. Meanwhile, Iroh gets a lethal rash so Zuko and Iroh head to a small Earth Kingdom town for help, hoping their real identities will not be discovered.

programs.title: Return to Omashu
programs.description: Despite the shocking news the gang have just discovered, Aang insists on trying to find Bumi within Omashu's borders, even with the dangers that will await him and his friends if his real identity is discovered.  Meanwhile Azula goes in search of old friends to help her with her mission.

programs.title: The Swamp
programs.description: A mysterious tornado pulls the kids into a supernatural swamp where Katara, Sokka and Aang have mysterious visions. Meanwhile, Momo and Appa are chased by rogue swamp dwellers and only Aang and the gang can save them.

programs.title: Avatar Day
programs.description: Aang and the gang discover an Earth town that celebrates something called "Avatar Day." But when they get there and learn the festival is of "anti-Avatar" sentiment and Aang is put on trial for a crime a past incarnation allegedly committed. Looking to clear the Avatar's good name, Katara and Sokka venture back to a familiar  place to gather evidence and discover the truth.

programs.title: The Blind Bandit
programs.description: In search for an earthbending teacher for Aang, the kids go to an underground earthbending tournament called Earth Rumble 6, where they encounter Toph, a blind but powerful earthbending girl. After seeing her unique style of earthbending, Aang wants Toph to become his teacher, but there are complications with Toph's family.

programs.title: Zuko Alone
programs.description: Zuko travels by himself to an Earth Kingdom town where he meets a local boy. The two almost become friends, while Zuko suffers from flashbacks of his past.

programs.title: The Chase
programs.description: Tired from trying to escape a machine that shows up every time they try to sleep, Aang and the gang have to escape Azula and her team, but their exhaustion leads to a tight situation. Meanwhile, Zuko must deal with something personal, and Iroh bonds with an unlikely individual.

programs.title: Bitter Work
programs.description: Toph's instructing abilities come into question when Aang cannot seem to overcome a block that keeps him from earthbending. Sokka gets himself in a jam, while befriending what was, moments before, his next meal, and Iroh and Zuko begin training utilizing new philosophies and methods that originate from the other elements.

programs.title: The Library
programs.description: When Aang and his friends find a professor who knows of a library that contains information about the world, Sokka decides to go there to hopefully find some information to use against the Fire Nation. The library is guarded by the knowledge spirit, Wan Shi Tong, who unfortunately doesn't welcome humans into his library, because he believes they only seek information for evil purposes.

programs.title: The Desert
programs.description: Aang searches for Appa while Katara struggles to keep everyone together to survive in the vast desert. Meanwhile, Iroh and Zuko seek help from an ancient secret society.

programs.title: The Serpent's Pass
programs.description: When Aang and the gang meet up with a group of refugees, they tell the gang where they can get on a ferry to Ba Sing Se. But after a series of events they have to take a deadly route called the serpent's pass with the help of an old friend, Suki. Meanwhile, Zuko and Iroh meet up with a boy named Jet and his freedom fighters.

programs.title: The Drill
programs.description: Having made it to the outer wall of Ba Sing Se, the kids confront a Fire Nation army that is driving a massive Fire Nation drill, which poses an imminent threat to the last Earth Kingdom stronghold. Meanwhile, Zuko and Iroh make crucial mistakes which begin to attract Jet's suspicions.

programs.title: City of Walls and Secrets
programs.description: Having finally made it into Ba Sing Se, the kids are given a house in the upper ring. The kids are anxious to tell the Earth King their plan but there are complications. Meanwhile, still convinced that Iroh and Zuko may be Fire Nation, Jet decides to take matters into his own hands and do whatever it takes to get the refugees to reveal their true nature.

programs.title: The Tales of Ba Sing Se
programs.description: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city. Tales of Katara and Toph, Iroh, Sokka, Aang, Zuko, and Momo.

programs.title: Appa's Lost Days
programs.description: Appa's journey from being abducted in the desert to the present is explored.

programs.title: Lake Laogai
programs.description: Aang and his friends continue to search for Appa and, unbeknownst to them, they aren't the only ones looking for him. During their search, the kids meet up with Jet, whom they are understandably reluctant to trust. The kids soon realize that the Dai Li are doing their best to thwart the kids' efforts to find Appa. Meanwhile, Iroh is offered his own tea shop in the upper ring, and Zuko discovers the avatar is in the city.

programs.title: The Earth King
programs.description: The kids battle Long Feng and the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city. Zuko becomes seriously ill and has feverish dreams as he faces a spiritual crisis.

programs.title: The Guru
programs.description: Aang travels to the Eastern Air temple to receive guidance from Guru Pathik while Sokka is reunited with his long-lost father. Meanwhile, Azula has something diabolical in store for her enemies in the Earth Kingdom, including Zuko and Iroh.

programs.title: The Crossroads of Destiny
programs.description: Everyone races against time to stop Azula's sinister plan. Zuko finds companionship in an unlikely source. Aang's destiny hangs in the balance—and so does Zuko's, as Iroh tells him it's time to make a choice.

programs.title: The Awakening
programs.description: After sustaining serious injuries at the end of season two, Aang awakens to find himself aboard a Fire Nation ship. Meanwhile, Zuko journeys home.

programs.title: The Headband
programs.description: To better camouflage themselves as real Fire Nation citizens, the kids check out a Fire Nation school. Avatar dance special. Also, Zuko confronts Uncle.

programs.title: The Painted Lady
programs.description: When the gang arrives at a suffering fishing village, a mysterious spirit appears to help the villagers.

programs.title: Sokka's Master
programs.description: When Sokka feels he's not contributing enough to the group, he seeks out a mysterious master to teach him the ways of the sword.

programs.title: The Beach
programs.description: Zuko, Azula, Mai, and Ty Lee go on vacation at Lo and Li's beach house, where they learn a lot about themselves and each other. Meanwhile, the kids face a new enemy.

programs.title: The Avatar and the Firelord
programs.description:
The Avatar and The Firelord

The world's power was split between the Earth, Fire, Water and Air nations. Only Aang could save it.

programs.title: The Runaway
programs.description: When Toph discovers a quick way to make cash, Katara disapproves, and the rift between them has disastrous consequences.

programs.title: The Puppetmaster
programs.description: The kids investigate mysterious disappearances in a spooky town. Katara makes a special connection.

programs.title: Nightmares and Daydreams
programs.description:
Nightmares and Daydreams

On the eve of the eclipse, Aang's anxiety gets the better of him. His dreams become nightmares, and soon he can no longer tell dream from reality.

programs.title: The Day of Black Sun: The Invasion (1)
programs.description: The day of the eclipse has arrived, and the invasion force gathers together to make last preparations. They infiltrate the island and the battle begins. Meanwhile, Aang searches for the Fire Lord.

programs.title: The Day of Black Sun: The Eclipse (2)
programs.description: As the invasion force fights their way to the Fire Nation capital, the kids help Aang find the Fire Lord in time for the eclipse. Zuko confronts his father with shocking news.

programs.title: The Western Air Temple
programs.description: Aang and the group arrive at the Western Air Temple, with Zuko in pursuit. Zuko wishes to help the Avatar end the war by teaching him firebending.

programs.title: The Firebending Masters
programs.description: While teaching Aang firebending, Zuko realizes that he has lost all his firebending skills. To regain his powers, Zuko and Aang must seek the original source of firebending within the ruins of a lost civilization.

programs.title: The Boiling Rock (1)
programs.description: Sokka wants to break his father out of jail and asks Zuko for information on Fire Nation prisons. Sokka and Zuko head for the Boiling Rock, a prison located in the middle of a volcano, to rescue Sokka's father.

programs.title: The Boiling Rock (2)
programs.description: Zuko and Sokka make new plans to break out of the prison with Suki, Sokka's father and some others while a shocking twist leaves Azula none too happy with her two closest friends.

programs.title: The Southern Raiders
programs.description: Katara decides to confront the Fire Nation soldier responsible for her mother's death. Aang tries to talk her out of it, but she doesn't listen.

programs.title: The Ember Island Players
programs.description: A play recounting the gang's adventures does not sit well with Aang and his friends, except for Toph who enjoys it very much. Meanwhile, Aang confesses his love to Katara, but the response is ambiguous.

programs.title: Sozin's Comet: The Phoenix King (1)
programs.description: Aang struggles to decide whether or not he has to kill the Fire Lord and, during the night, is drawn toward an island which disappears before morning. Zuko leads the rest of the group to the Earth Kingdom to meet a tracker whom they hope can find Aang. The Fire Lord crowns himself Phoenix King and Aang awakens on the island not knowing where he is.

programs.title: Sozin's Comet: The Old Masters (2)
programs.description: While on the island, Aang seeks guidance from his past lives, but is not pleased with what he is told. The island, in fact, turns out to be a lion turtle from which Aang is given the guidance he had been seeking. Meanwhile, after the tracker is unable to track Aang, the rest of the group decide they must find Iroh. While tracking him down, the group meets up with The Order of the White Lotus, a group that transcends the division of the four nations.

programs.title: Sozin's Comet: Into the Inferno (3)
programs.description: Sokka, Suki, and Toph try to stop the Fire Nation's air fleet. Meanwhile, Zuko and Azula duel in an Agni Kai and Aang confronts the Fire Lord.

programs.title: Sozin's Comet: Avatar Aang (4)
programs.description: Aang is on the offensive after getting hit in the back of his scar and triggering the Avatar State. Meanwhile, after Zuko seems to have the upper hand against Azula, Katara is forced to join the fight when Azula resorts to desperate measures.

programs.title: Tourist Trapped
programs.description: When Dipper and Mabel Pines arrive to spend their summer break in the remote town of Gravity Falls, Mabel’s suspiciously weird new boyfriend causes the twins to come face to face with the town’s strange and uncanny secrets.

programs.title: The Legend of the Gobblewonker
programs.description: When Dipper and Mabel hear rumors of a sea monster that lives at the bottom of the local lake, they enlist Soos to take them on a boating expedition to prove it really does exist.

programs.title: Headhunters
programs.description: When someone tampers with Mabel's life-size wax statue of Grunkle Stan, she and Dipper set out to find the culprit. Meanwhile, Grunkle Stan mourns over the loss of his wax doppelganger.

programs.title: The Hand That Rocks the Mabel
programs.description: Dipper and Mabel discover that their seemingly cherubic new neighbor, Lil' Gideon, happens to be the town's adored psychic. But when Lil' Gideon guilts her into dating him, she and Dipper soon learn that his cuteness can fade all too quickly.

programs.title: The Inconveniencing
programs.description: Dipper is invited by Wendy and her teen friends on a trek that leads to an abandoned convenience store that may be haunted.

programs.title: Dipper vs. Manliness
programs.description: In a quest to attain manliness, Dipper ventures into the forest to battle the notorious Multi-Bear. Meanwhile, Mabel tries to teach Grunkle Stan how to be attractive to women, particularly the waitress in the local diner, Lazy Susan.

programs.title: Double Dipper
programs.description: Stan throws a big weekend party to promote the Mystery Shack. Dipper makes clones of himself to impress Wendy. Mabel fights for the Party Queen title in honor of her two friends.

programs.title: Irrational Treasure
programs.description: When Dipper and Mabel discover evidence that the reported town founder is a hoax, they set out to expose the historical cover-up and prove that Mabel's silliness is not a bad thing.

programs.title: The Time Traveler's Pig
programs.description: Dipper wants to correct a mistake he made in the past with assistance from a time machine. Mabel is overjoyed when she wins a pet pig at a fair.

programs.title: Fight Fighters
programs.description: After being challenged to a fight by Wendy's boyfriend Robbie, Dipper is shocked when his favorite Fight Fighters fighter, Rumble McSkirmish, comes to life to defend him, but Dipper soon loses control of Rumble and has to find a way to stop him from seriously injuring Robbie

programs.title: Little Dipper
programs.description: Dipper is self-conscious that Mabel is taller than him and seeks a magic solution. Meanwhile Lil' Gideon takes advantage of Dipper's and Mabel's height discrepancy.

programs.title: Summerween
programs.description: Dipper and Mabel go trick-or-treating in the summer and encounter a candy-loving monster who threatens to devour them if they don't bring him sweet things to eat.

programs.title: Boss Mabel
programs.description: Mabel bets Grunkle Stan that she will make more money at the Mystery Shack by treating people nicely than he does by being rude and cranky.

programs.title: Bottomless Pit!
programs.description: While Stan, Dipper, Mabel and Soos are falling in a bottomless pit, they tell stories to pass the time.

programs.title: The Deep End
programs.description: When Mabel befriends a cute merman trapped in the public pool, she's determined to help him out. Meanwhile, Dipper decides to volunteer as a lifeguard to see Wendy.

programs.title: Carpet Diem
programs.description: The twins discover a hidden room inside the Mystery Shack and compete over who should have it.

programs.title: Boyz Crazy
programs.description: When Mabel discovers that her favorite boy band is actually a bunch of imprisoned clones, she sets them free, only to decide on keeping them for herself. Meanwhile, Dipper is convinced that Robbie plans to brainwash Wendy with a secret message hidden inside one of his songs.

programs.title: Land Before Swine
programs.description: When Waddles is snatched by a prehistoric beast, Dipper, Mabel, Stan, Soos, and Old Man McGucket must journey to a mysterious land trapped in time to rescue him.

programs.title: Dreamscaperers (1)
programs.description: Dipper, Mabel, and Soos must travel through Grunkle Stan's mind to defeat a tricky dream demon summoned by Lil Gideon.

programs.title: Gideon Rises (2)
programs.description: Li'l Gideon swindles the Mystery Shack away, forcing Grunkle Stan and the kids to move in with Soos. While Stan weighs how he can still care for his grandniece and nephew, they decide to take on Gideon.

programs.title: Scary-oke
programs.description: The Pines family is starting to get everything back to normal after the Lil' Gideon incident. They throw a “Mystery Shack Is Back” party, but some unwelcome guests intend to crash it.

programs.title: Into the Bunker
programs.description: Dipper’s secret journal pages lead him and the gang to the author’s hidden bunker where they find themselves face-to-face with a mysterious figure from Gravity Falls’ lore.

programs.title: The Golf War
programs.description: After being belittled by Pacifica one too many times, Mabel challenges her to a miniature golf-off which gets a tad out of control when some local residents offer their help.

programs.title: Sock Opera
programs.description: Mabel decides to put on a sock puppet rock opera to impress a local puppeteer, but her show goes awry when Dipper's drive to uncover more of the journal's secrets leads to a supernatural disaster.

programs.title: Soos and the Real Girl
programs.description: Soos needs a date for his cousin Reggie's engagement party and looks to a dating simulator game to help him talk to girls.

programs.title: Little Gift Shop of Horrors
programs.description: In three separate mysterious tales, Stan is cursed by a Witch, Waddles accidentally eats a bowl of brain-enhancing jelly and builds a machine that allows him to speak, and Mabel faces her fear of claymation.

programs.title: Society of the Blind Eye
programs.description: The kids, along with Old Man McGucket's help, discover there is a secret society in Gravity Falls.

programs.title: Blendin's Game
programs.description: Blendin returns to face off with Dipper and Mabel in a futuristic battle that could trap them forever in time jail.

programs.title: The Love God
programs.description: Mabel takes matchmaking too far when she steals a love potion from a real Love God.

programs.title: Northwest Mansion Mystery
programs.description: Pacifica enlists Dipper’s help to rid the Northwest Mansion of a ghost before he wreaks havoc on her fancy party.

programs.title: Not What He Seems
programs.description: After agents Powers and Trigger take Stan into custody, Dipper and Mabel begin to wonder how much they actually know about their Grunkle Stan.

programs.title: A Tale of Two Stans
programs.description: Cornered underneath the Mystery Shack, Stan must finally reveal the secrets of his past and his mysterious portal to Dipper and Mabel.

programs.title: Dungeons, Dungeons, and More Dungeons
programs.description: Dipper finds an unlikely friend to join him with his newest obsession — a board game called “Dungeons, Dungeons, and More Dungeons.”

programs.title: The Stanchurian Candidate
programs.description: When Grunkle Stan decides to run for mayor, Dipper and Mabel have their work cut out for them trying to turn their gaffe-prone uncle into the perfect candidate.

programs.title: The Last Mabelcorn
programs.description: A new threat leads Mabel to venture into the enchanted realm of the unicorns. Meanwhile, Dipper learns an unexpected twist about the enigmatic Bill Cipher.

programs.title: Roadside Attraction
programs.description: Grunkle Stan takes the kids with him on a road-trip to sabotage all the other tourist traps in Oregon.

programs.title: Dipper and Mabel vs. The Future
programs.description: Mabel decides to plan for her and Dipper's 13th birthday party. Meanwhile, Dipper and Ford venture below the town to find its most shocking secret.

programs.title: Weirdmageddon 1: Xpcveaoqfoxso
programs.description: Trapped in the apocalypse and menaced by villains new and old, Dipper finds himself in a race against time.

programs.title: Weirdmageddon 2: Escape from Reality
programs.description: Dipper, Soos and Wendy must save Mabel from a strange new world, while Bill's forces plan their next move.

programs.title: Weirdmageddon 3: Take Back the Falls
programs.description: In the series finale, the Mystery Shack crew and townsfolk fight against Bill Cipher and his minions in a final stand to defeat them once and for all and save the town of Gravity Falls and the world.

programs.title: Help Wanted
programs.description: SpongeBob finally applies for a job at the Krusty Krab.

programs.title: Reef Blower
programs.description: SpongeBob finds the perfect use for his high powered reef blower.

programs.title: Tea at the Treedome
programs.description: SpongeBob meets Sandy Cheeks for the first time.

programs.title: Bubblestand
programs.description: SpongeBob introduces his unique talent of bubble blowing.

programs.title: Ripped Pants
programs.description: When SpongeBob tries to impress Sandy Cheeks at Mussel Beach, he ends up ripping his pants.

programs.title: Jellyfishing
programs.description: While Squidward recovers from a bicycle accident, SpongeBob and Patrick takes him jellyfishing.

programs.title: Plankton!
programs.description: SpongeBob falls victim to a scheme by the evil Plankton.

programs.title: Naughty Nautical Neighbors
programs.description: Squidward plays a joke on SpongeBob and Patrick, but the joke backfires on Squidward.

programs.title: Boating School
programs.description: It's exam time again at Mrs. Puff's Boating School.

programs.title: Pizza Delivery
programs.description: Mr. Krabs has SpongeBob and Squidward make the first successful pizza delivery.

programs.title: Home Sweet Pineapple
programs.description: SpongeBob is losing his pineapple house to parasites.

programs.title: Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy
programs.description: SpongeBob and Patrick visits Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy at the retirement home.

programs.title: Pickles
programs.description: SpongeBob loses his self-confidence when an arrogant customer claims SpongeBob forgot to put pickles on his Krabby Patty.

programs.title: Hall Monitor
programs.description: Mrs. Puff's Boating School picks SpongeBob as this weeks Hall Monitor.

programs.title: Jellyfish Jam
programs.description: Over the repeated warning of his friends, SpongeBob takes a wild jellyfish home.

programs.title: Sandy's Rocket
programs.description: Sandy has taken on the enviable mission of taking a rocket ship into outer space.

programs.title: Squeaky Boots
programs.description: Mr. Krabs surreptitiously gives SpongeBob a pair of squeaky boots in lieu of pay.

programs.title: Nature Pants
programs.description: SpongeBob decides to leave his industrialized life and live off the land with the jellyfish.

programs.title: Opposite Day
programs.description: Fed up with SpongeBob and Patrick, Squidward decides to sell his house.

programs.title: Culture Shock
programs.description: There's a talent show at the Krusty Krab and Squidward takes over the planning.

programs.title: F.U.N.
programs.description: The evil Plankton tries to steal a Krusty Krabs' Krabby Patty.

programs.title: MuscleBob BuffPants
programs.description: SpongeBob gets pumped up with the aid of inflatable muscles.

programs.title: Squidward the Unfriendly Ghost
programs.description: Squidward's accidental pasting by a flying shell haunts SpongeBob and Patrick.

programs.title: The Chaperone
programs.description: When Mr. Krabs' daughter Pearl is stood up, SpongeBob agrees to step in.

programs.title: Employee of the Month
programs.description: Mr. Krabs dupes SpongeBob into believing he might break his winning streak and lose to Squidward.

programs.title: Scaredy Pants
programs.description: It's Halloween and SpongeBob is the easiest to scare in Bikini Bottom.

programs.title: I Was a Teenage Gary
programs.description: Squidward reluctantly agrees to take care of SpongeBob's pet snail, Gary.

programs.title: SB-129
programs.description: Fleeing from SpongeBob and Patrick's consistent noise, Squidward winds up frozen.

programs.title: Karate Choppers
programs.description: SpongeBob and Sandy's incessant Karate sparring is starting to wreak havoc in the Krusty Krab.

programs.title: Sleepy Time
programs.description: SpongeBob suddenly posses the ability to visit the dreams of his friends.

programs.title: Suds
programs.description: SpongeBob comes down with a case of the Suds, an illness which turns him into a bubble-maker.

programs.title: Valentine's Day
programs.description: Patrick feels snubbed when SpongeBob's Valentine's Day gift doesn't arrive as planned.

programs.title: The Paper
programs.description: SpongeBob turns Squidward's old gum wrapper into a magical toy.

programs.title: Arrgh!
programs.description: A pretend search for gold turns into a real treasure hunt.

programs.title: Rock Bottom
programs.description: SpongeBob gets on the wrong bus and finds himself lost in a mysterious part of the sea.

programs.title: Texas
programs.description: Sandy is homesick and plans to return home.

programs.title: Walking Small
programs.description: The evil Plankton is up to no good once again when he tries to manipulate SpongeBob.

programs.title: Fools in April
programs.description: Squidward decides to teach SpongeBob what a REAL April Fool's Day prank is like.

programs.title: Neptune's Spatula
programs.description: SpongeBob seizes the mythical spatula of King Neptune.

programs.title: Hooky
programs.description: Mr. Krabs warns SpongeBob and Patrick to beware the dangerous fishing hooks!

programs.title: Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy II
programs.description: SpongeBob joins Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy on patrol.

programs.title: Something Smells
programs.description: SpongeBob eats sea onion ice cream and his breath stinks. When people avoid him, Patrick convinces him that it's because he's ugly.

programs.title: Bossy Boots
programs.description: When Mr. Krabs gives his daughter Pearl a job at the Krusty krab, she starts to make some changes.

programs.title: Your Shoe's Untied
programs.description: Patrick gets a new pair of shoes, but doesn't know how to tie his laces.

programs.title: Squid's Day Off
programs.description: Mr. Krabs takes the day off from the Krusty Krab and puts Squidward in charge.

programs.title: Big Pink Loser
programs.description: Patrick goes overboard when he takes SpongeBob on as a role model.

programs.title: Bubble Buddy
programs.description: SpongeBob blows a bubble to keep him company when Patrick goes out of town.

programs.title: Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy III
programs.description: When Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy go away for the weekend, they ask SpongeBob and Patrick to house sit for them.

programs.title: Squirrel Jokes
programs.description: SpongeBob becomes an overnight stand up comedy sensation when he starts telling derogatory jokes about squirrels.

programs.title: Dying for Pie
programs.description: Squidward accidentally lets SpongeBob eat an exploding pie.

programs.title: Imitation Krabs
programs.description: Plankton schemes to steal the Krabby patty by disguising himself as Mr. Krabs.

programs.title: Wormy
programs.description: SpongeBob and Patrick are convinced a butterfly ate Sandy's pet caterpillar.

programs.title: Patty Hype
programs.description: SpongeBob's colored patty sales idea becomes a huge success and Mr. Krabs wants a piece of the pie.

programs.title: Survival of the Idiots
programs.description: SpongeBob and Patrick are fascinated by the snow they see inside the Treedome and want to play in it, but Sandy is hibernating for the winter.

programs.title: Dumped
programs.description: SpongeBob grows more and more jealous as Gary spends more time with Patrick.

programs.title: Grandma's Kisses
programs.description: SpongeBob's friends tease him after Grammaw gives him a kiss.

programs.title: Squidville
programs.description: Sick and tired of living between SpongeBob and Patrick, Squidward decides to move out of Bikini Bottom.

programs.title: No Free Rides
programs.description: SpongeBob attempts and fails his driving test again, but a fed up Mrs. Puff wants him out of her classroom so she makes up extra credit for him so he can pass the test.

programs.title: I'm Your Biggest Fanatic
programs.description: SpongeBob tries to join an exclusive jellyfishing club.

programs.title: Shanghaied
programs.description: SpongeBob and Patrick work as crew members for The Flying Dutchman.

programs.title: Pressure
programs.description: Sandy and SpongeBob get into a fierce competition doing extreme underwater sports.

programs.title: The Smoking Peanut
programs.description: SpongeBob and Patrick visit the zoo and SpongeBob innocently tosses a peanut at an oyster in order to rouse it. The oyster then goes crazy.

programs.title: Prehibernation Week
programs.description: Sandy is going into hibernation in a week and she wants to pack in a million activities.

programs.title: Life of Crime
programs.description: SpongeBob and Patrick end up popping Mr. Krabs balloon and fear the consequences.

programs.title: The Secret Box
programs.description: Patrick has a box and won't show SpongeBob what's inside. SpongeBob's curiousity gets the best of him.

programs.title: Band Geeks
programs.description: Squidward's old rival brags to Squid about his famous marching band. Feeling outdone, Squid says he has a band too.

programs.title: Sailor Mouth
programs.description: SpongeBob reads a "bad" word off a dumpster behind the Krusty Krab and he doesn't know what it means.

programs.title: Artist Unknown
programs.description: When SpongeBob enrolls in Squidward's community art class, arrogant Squidward attempts to teach him strictly by the book.

programs.title: Jellyfish Hunter
programs.description: Mr. Krabs discovers that customers love SpongeBob's special jellyfish "Jelly Krabby Patty". He begins to take advantage of the jellyfish.

programs.title: The Fry Cook Games
programs.description: Mr. Krabs enters SpongeBob in the Fry Cook Games where he competes against Patrick.

programs.title: Just One Bite
programs.description: SpongeBob becomes obsessed with the fact that Squidward has never actually tried a Krabby Patty.

programs.title: The Bully
programs.description: The new bully in school, Flats, threatens to beat SpongeBob up after school.

programs.title: Squid on Strike
programs.description: Believing Mr. Krabs is taking advantage, Squidward convinces SpongeBob to join with him and threaten Mr. Krabs with a strike.

programs.title: Sandy, SpongeBob, and the Worm
programs.description: A large worm is terrorizing Bikini Bottom and SpongeBob is terrified of it.

programs.title: Procrastination
programs.description: SpongeBob must write an 800 word essay for boating school but gets distracted easily.

programs.title: I'm with Stupid
programs.description: When Patrick's parents come over for Starfish Day, Patrick gets upset that they still think he isn't very smart.

programs.title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
programs.description: When Homer doesn’t receive his Christmas bonus, and Marge having to spend the family's Christmas savings to erase Bart’s tattoo, he is forced to become a department store Santa to hide the fact he didn't get the bonus.

programs.title: Bart the Genius
programs.description: After switching IQ tests with Martin, Bart is mistaken for a child genius. When he's enrolled in a school for gifted students, a series of embarrassments and mishaps makes him long for his old life.

programs.title: Homer's Odyssey
programs.description: Homer is fired for nearly causing a meltdown at the nuclear plant. Unable to provide for his family, he contemplates ending it all - until he discovers a new life path as a campaigner for safety.

programs.title: There's No Disgrace Like Home
programs.description: After an embarrassing experience at the company picnic, Homer pawns the TV and uses the proceeds to take the family to therapy sessions.

programs.title: Bart the General
programs.description: Fed up with Nelson's bullying, the kids from Springfield Elementary decide to teach him a lesson. With advice from Grandpa, Bart leads them into battle.

programs.title: Moaning Lisa
programs.description: When Lisa get a bad case of the blues, jazz musician Bleeding Gums Murphy teaches her how to express her feelings through music.

programs.title: The Call of the Simpsons
programs.description: Homer buys an RV and the family takes off on an ill-fated camping trip.

programs.title: The Telltale Head
programs.description: Bart tries to impress the school bullies by stealing the head of the Jebediah Springfield statue in the town square, but everyone is outraged by his act of vandalism.

programs.title: Life on the Fast Lane
programs.description: Homer gives Marge a bowling ball for her birthday, and his self-serving gift backfires: she starts taking lessons from a suave French bowling instructor. When the lessons take a romantic turn, Marge faces temptation.

programs.title: Homer's Night Out
programs.description: Bart puts his new spy camera to use when Homer gets rowdy at a bachelor party, and the incriminating photo gets distributed all over town.

programs.title: The Crepes of Wrath
programs.description: Bart is sent as a foreign exchange student to France, where he is enslaved by corrupt winemakers. Meanwhile, the Simpson family hosts an Albanian student who takes a surprising interest in the workings of the nuclear power plant.

programs.title: Krusty Gets Busted
programs.description: Krusty the Clown gets busted for robbing the Kwik-E-Mart, with Homer as an eyewitness. Convinced that their idol was wrongly accused, Bart and Lisa investigate the crime.

programs.title: Some Enchanted Evening
programs.description: While Homer takes Marge out for a night on the town, the kids spot their babysitter on America's Most Armed and Dangerous.

programs.title: Bart Gets an F
programs.description: In danger of flunking the fourth grade, Bart strikes a deal with the class brain: in exchange for tutoring, he will help Martin become more popular.

programs.title: Simpson and Delilah
programs.description: After Homer charges a miracle hair growth treatment to the company's health insurance, his new found confidence gets him a promotion.

programs.title: Treehouse of Horror
programs.description: The family moves into a haunted mansion, Aliens abduct the Simpsons and invite them to what might be their last supper, and Lisa reads Bart Edgar Allan Poe's classic poem "The Raven."

programs.title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
programs.description: When a three-eyed fish is found in a nearby stream, the Springfield Nuclear Power Plant faces bad publicity and fails an inspection. Mr. Burns runs for governor, but his spin doctors are no match for Marge.

programs.title: Dancin' Homer
programs.description: Homer becomes a local celebrity as the Springfield Isotopes' mascot. When he's promoted to the big leagues, the family moves to Capital City.

programs.title: Dead Putting Society
programs.description: Competition erupts between neighbors when Todd Flanders and Bart enter a miniature golf tournament. Facing increasing pressure from their fathers, the boys find a way to settle things.

programs.title: Bart vs. Thanksgiving
programs.description: Bart ruins Thanksgiving when he accidentally destroys Lisa's Thanksgiving centerpiece. Angry at being asked to apologize, he runs away and roams Springfield in search of dinner.

programs.title: Bart the Daredevil
programs.description: Bart decides to emulate his hero, daredevil Lance Murdoch, and performs increasingly risky stunts on his skateboard. When he sets his sights on Springfield Gorge, Homer intervenes.

programs.title: Itchy & Scratchy & Marge
programs.description: Marge wages a one-woman campaign against violence on the Itchy and Scratchy Show. She wins that battle, but draws the line at censoring Michelangelo's "David."

programs.title: Bart Gets Hit by a Car
programs.description: After Mr. Burns hits Bart with his car, ambulance-chasing attorney Lionel Hutz persuades Homer and Marge to sue for a million dollars.

programs.title: One Fish, Two Fish, Blowfish, Blue Fish
programs.description: After eating poisonous blowfish at a sushi restaurant, Homer decides to live life to the fullest in the 24 hours he has left to live.

programs.title: The Way We Was
programs.description: When the TV breaks, Marge and Homer entertain the kids with the story of how they first met.

programs.title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
programs.description: Homer becomes the most popular guy in town when he gets an illegal cable hook-up, but Lisa fears he will go to hell for violating the Eighth Commandment.

programs.title: Principal Charming
programs.description: When Marge begs Homer to find Selma a husband, he sets her up with Principal Skinner... who falls in love with Patty instead.

programs.title: Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?
programs.description: Homer's long-lost half-brother is the CEO of a car company that's wildly successful... until he hires Homer to help design a car for the average man.

programs.title: Bart's Dog Gets an F
programs.description: After a series of destructive acts, Homer decides that Santa's Little Helper must go unless he passes obedience school. As the dog's last hours with the family approach, Bart must find a way to get through to him.

programs.title: Old Money
programs.description: When Grandpa's new girlfriend at the Springfield Retirement Castle dies, he inherits her savings and must decide the best way to spend his windfall.

programs.title: Brush with Greatness
programs.description: Marge rediscovers her interest in art and takes up painting. When Mr. Burns hires her to paint his official portrait, Marge tries but fails to find his “inner beauty.”

programs.title: Lisa's Substitute
programs.description: With Miss Hoover out sick, a substitute teacher takes over the class and becomes an inspiring role model for Lisa.

programs.title: The War of the Simpsons
programs.description: At a lakeside retreat for married couples, Marge is determined to fix her marriage with Homer, but Homer is more determined to catch General Sherman, the freakishly large catfish that lives in the lake.

programs.title: Three Men and a Comic Book
programs.description: Bart, Milhouse, and Martin pool their money to buy the first issue of Radioactive Man, but their investment and their friendship are threatened when they can't agree on who will keep it.

programs.title: Blood Feud
programs.description: When Mr. Burns is saved by a transfusion of Bart's blood, Homer expects a handsome reward but is outraged to receive only a simple thank-you note.

programs.title: Stark Raving Dad
programs.description: Mistakenly committed to a mental hospital, Homer meets a tall, stocky white man who claims to be Michael Jackson.

programs.title: Mr. Lisa Goes to Washington
programs.description: Lisa’s patriotic essay wins the family a trip to Washington, D.C., but the corruption she sees there inspires her to write a new and very different essay.

programs.title: When Flanders Failed
programs.description: When Ned Flanders opens a store for left-handed people, Homer wants him to fail...

programs.title: Bart the Murderer
programs.description: Bart becomes an errand boy for the Springfield Mafia. When Principal Skinner disappears, Fat Tony points the finger at Bart.

programs.title: Homer Defined
programs.description: Homer averts a meltdown through sheer dumb luck. When he’s invited to the Shelbyville Nuclear Power Plant to give a pep talk, he faces another potential meltdown and again “pulls a Homer.”

programs.title: Like Father, Like Clown
programs.description: Bart and Lisa work to reunite Krusty the Clown with his estranged father, an Orthodox Jewish rabbi who had never accepted Krusty’s career choice.

programs.title: Treehouse of Horror II
programs.description: The family buys a cursed monkey paw in Morocco, and their three wishes turn out badly. In a Twilight Zone parody, Bart is the fearsome “monster” who can read the townspeople’s thoughts. And Mr. Burns steals Homer’s brain for a giant robot he’s building.

programs.title: Lisa's Pony
programs.description: Overcompensating for his neglect, Homer buys Lisa a pony. The high cost of maintaining the animal forces him to work the graveyard shift at the Kwik-E-Mart.

programs.title: Saturdays of Thunder
programs.description: Homer tries to bond with Bart by building a soapbox racer. On race day, Bart must decide between driving Martin’s aerodynamic racer and disappointing Homer, or driving his own racer and losing to Nelson.

programs.title: Flaming Moe's
programs.description: Moe steals the drink recipe Homer invented, and the rechristened “Flaming Moe” turns his tavern into a hotspot. When a national franchise wants to buy the recipe, Homer wants revenge.

programs.title: Burns Verkaufen der Kraftwerk
programs.description: Mr. Burns sells the Springfield Nuclear Power Plant to wealthy German investors who are shocked at the conditions.

programs.title: I Married Marge
programs.description: Homer and Marge recount their early years, when the couple faced a shotgun wedding and Homer’s poor career prospects.

programs.title: Radio Bart
programs.description: Bart plays practical jokes with a radio microphone, and his hoax tests the limits of the town’s kindness.

programs.title: Lisa the Greek
programs.description: Sundays become “Daddy-Daughter Days” when Homer discovers Lisa’s uncanny ability to pick winning football teams.

programs.title: Homer Alone
programs.description: Marge has a nervous breakdown and goes on a vacation alone, leaving Bart and Lisa with Patty and Selma, and Maggie with Homer.

programs.title: Bart the Lover
programs.description: Bart discovers his teacher’s personal ad and invents a fictional suitor to string her along. When Mrs. Krabappel falls madly in love with “Woodrow,” Bart’s conscience starts to bother him.

programs.title: Homer at the Bat
programs.description: Homer and his co-workers qualify for the plant softball team's league final, but Mr. Burns hires nine professional MLB players in order to win a $1 million bet.

programs.title: Separate Vocations
programs.description: When a career aptitude test pegs Lisa as a homemaker and Bart as a police officer, the results cause them to make 180-degree turns in their behavior.

programs.title: Dog of Death
programs.description: After the Simpsons regret paying for an expensive surgery for Santa's Little Helper, he runs away from home and is trained by Mr. Burns to become an attack dog.

programs.title: Colonel Homer
programs.description: Homer becomes the manager of a beautiful country music singer, whose attentions drive a wedge between Marge and Homer.

programs.title: Black Widower
programs.description: When Selma agrees to marry her prison pen pal, Sideshow Bob, only Bart remains suspicious of his motives.

programs.title: The Otto Show
programs.description: Otto loses his job driving the school bus and the Simpsons take him in. When he must get a driver’s license, he finds common ground with Patty and Selma.

programs.title: Bart's Friend Falls in Love
programs.description: Everything’s coming up Milhouse when Bart’s best friend falls in love with the new girl at school. Jealous, Bart snitches to Milhouse’s father and the lovebirds are separated.

programs.title: Brother, Can You Spare Two Dimes?
programs.description: After Homer "wins" a $2000 settlement with the plant for radiation affecting his sperm count, his brother Herb returns to Springfield with an idea that could help him get his fortune back.

programs.title: Space Pilot 3000
programs.description: On New Year's Eve 1999, Pizza Delivery boy Philip J. Fry accidentally falls into a cryogenic chamber and is frozen for 1,000 years. Finally unfrozen, he explores New New York, meets his new best friend (a kleptomaniacal robot named Bender) and goes to work for his great-great-great-great-grand-nephew's space delivery business.

programs.title: The Series Has Landed
programs.description: For the crew's first mission, they must deliver a crate full of toys for an arcade game to the moon. Fry is very excited, while it is not really a big deal in the year 3000. Fry tries to persuade Leela to go exploring on the moon, while Amy tries to recover the keys to the Planet Express Ship.

programs.title: I, Roommate
programs.description: When it is discovered that Philip has been living in the Planet Express office, he is forced to move out. Trying to sleep standing up in Bender's closet-sized apartment doesn't work, so they go looking for a place both can be comfortable. Unfortunately, Bender is incompatible with the ideal apartment they do find until he has a radical... modification which makes him less than happy.

programs.title: Love's Labours Lost in Space
programs.description: On a mission intended to save endangered animals on a collapsing planet, Leela and the crew run into legendary starship captain Zapp Brannigan. A self-proclaimed ladies man, Zapp sees Leela as a potential new conquest. When the captain refuses to aid the animal rescue, Leela and her crew try to leave Zapp's starship. But Zapp throws Fry and Bender in jail, and summons Leela to his "Lovenasium". They ultimately escape and arrive on the doomed planet, where Leela finally finds love - with a cute, and very useful, creature named Nibbler.

programs.title: Fear of a Bot Planet
programs.description: Fry and Leela disguise themselves as robots to find Bender after he fails to return from a delivery to a robot planet, only to learn that he has become a celebrity in a culture which fears humans.

programs.title: A Fishful of Dollars
programs.description: Fry discovers his bank account interest has made him a billionaire and buys the one thing the year 3000 doesn't have, anchovies.

programs.title: My Three Suns
programs.description: Delivery Boy Philip J. Fry is promoted to Emperor after accidentally drinking his fluid-based predecessor.

programs.title: A Big Piece of Garbage
programs.description: A big piece of garbage that was released a thousand years ago is now on the way to Earth to destroy it. After Fry, Leela and Bender fail on placing a bomb on it, the city has to build another big piece of garbage, yet that may be a problem since trash doesn't exist in year 3000.

programs.title: Hell Is Other Robots
programs.description: During a Beastie Boys concert, Bender runs into a high school buddy, Fender. He invites him to a party, which turns out to be robots getting high off of electricity, or "jacking on". After one try, Bender is hooked.

programs.title: A Flight to Remember
programs.description: The Planet Express crew take a space cruise vacation. Leela tells Captain Zapp Brannigan that Fry is her boyfriend and Amy tells the same thing to her parents. Bender falls in love with a rich female robot. Problems start when the spaceship approaches a black hole.

programs.title: Mars University
programs.description: Fry, Leela, Bender and Farnsworth have to go to Mars University where Fry has to share a room with a talking monkey, Farnsworth's last invention. The monkey becomes a real headache when he starts beating Fry in all areas. Meanwhile, Bender is hanging out with nerd robots.

programs.title: When Aliens Attack
programs.description: The Omicronians invade Earth, demanding to see the lost final episode of the 1999 TV show Single Female Lawyer. The Planet Express crew must re-enact the episode to appease the invading aliens.

programs.title: Fry & the Slurm Factory
programs.description: When Fry wins a free tour of the Slurm soda factory, he and his friends split off from the tour group and make a horrifying discovery concerning the "secret ingredient" that makes Slurm so addictive.

programs.title: I Second That Emotion
programs.description: Professor Farnsworth installs an empathy chip in Bender after the inconsiderate robot flushes Nibbler down the toilet. With his newfound emotions, a concerned Bender ventures into the mutant-infested sewers to rescue Leela's beloved pet.

programs.title: Brannigan, Begin Again
programs.description: Upon destroying the new DOOP headquarters, Zapp Brannigan and Kif find themselves court-martialed and dishonorably discharged. They take up jobs at Planet Express, where Kif learns what respect feels like and Zapp incites a mutiny against Leela.

programs.title: A Head in the Polls
programs.description: When the price of titanium skyrockets, Bender pawns his titanium-rich body and lives the high life as just a head. But when the head-in-a-jar of Richard M. Nixon uses Bender's body to run for election for President of Earth, Bender vows to get his rightful property back.

programs.title: Xmas Story
programs.description: To apologize for an inconsiderate remark, Fry searches for the perfect Xmas gift for Leela, all the while trying to avoid the murderous SantaBot, whose standards for niceness are astronomically high.

programs.title: Why Must I Be a Crustacean in Love?
programs.description: When Dr. Zoidberg runs amok during the Decapodian mating season, Fry sets out to teach him how to woo a mate. Things backfire when Zoidberg's desired mate falls for Fry instead, and Zoidberg challenges Fry to a battle to the death.

programs.title: Put Your Head on My Shoulders
programs.description: Fry's brief relationship with Amy is forcibly prolonged when a near-fatal car crash leaves Fry's head grafted to Amy's left shoulder. Meanwhile, Bender cashes in on Valentine's Day by starting a dating service.

programs.title: Lesser of Two Evils
programs.description: Fry suspects Bender's new buddy, a bending unit named Flexo who looks almost exactly like Bender, of being pure evil. When a valuable atom of Jumbonium goes missing, Fry suspects Flexo, but can't tell which robot is which.

programs.title: Raging Bender
programs.description: Bender is the featured attraction in the Ultimate Robot Fighting League, but his glory is short-lived when he is instructed to intentionally lose his next match. Leela vows to lead Bender to victory, in an effort to show up her unsupportive martial arts teacher.

programs.title: A Bicyclops Built For Two
programs.description: Leela meets Alkazar, who claims to be the only other remaining cyclops in the universe. But when Alkazar invites Leela back to his home planet and treats her like a slave, Fry suspects that something is amiss.

programs.title: How Hermes Requisitioned His Groove Back
programs.description: When Hermes takes a stress-relieving vacation, replacement bureaucrat Morgan Proctor becomes infatuated with Fry. Bender threatens to publicize their affair, but Morgan removes Bender's memory and hides it within the cavernous Central Bureaucracy.

programs.title: A Clone of My Own
programs.description: Professor Farnsworth unveils his clone, Cubert Farnsworth, whom he plans to leave everything to upon his retirement. But Cubert wants no part of Farnsworth's lifestyle, prompting the professor into a premature retirement on the Near-Death Star.

programs.title: The Deep South
programs.description: A fishing trip over the ocean takes a turn for the worse when a colossal mouth bass pulls the Planet Express ship to the bottom of the sea. There, Fry falls in love with a mermaid named Umbriel, and the crew discovers the sunken city of Atlanta, Georgia.

programs.title: Bender Gets Made
programs.description: Bender takes a new job in the Robot Mafia, but his loyalty is tested when he goes along on the robotic gangster's efforts to rob the Planet Express ship.

programs.title: The Problem with Popplers
programs.description: The crew discovers an irresistible source of food on a distant planet, and brings it back to Earth to be sold at the Fishy Joe's restaurant chain. But when it's discovered that the so-called "Popplers" are actually Omicronian babies, the Omicronians demand recompense.

programs.title: Mother's Day
programs.description: Mom reprograms the world's robots to rebel against humanity. The only hope of salvation is Mom's old flame - Professor Farnsworth, who must rekindle his romance with Mom in order to save mankind.

programs.title: Anthology of Interest I
programs.description: The Professor's "What-If" machine simulates Bender, Leela and Fry's wishes. Bender discovers what it would be like if he were 500 feet tall, Leela discovers what it would be like if she were more impulsive, and Fry discovers what would happen if he never came to the future.

programs.title: The Honking
programs.description: When the inheritance Bender claims in the Old Country isn't quite what he expected, the Planet Express crew has to find the source of an age-old curse.

programs.title: War Is the H-Word
programs.description: Fry and Bender enlist in the army to get a soldiers discount for bubblegum. When they are called to fight a war on a planet of bouncing ball aliens, Leela disguises herself as man to enlist with them. Bender is eventually sent to parley with the enemy, but this turns out to be a ploy.

programs.title: The Cryonic Woman
programs.description: Fry is reunited with his old girlfriend from the 20th Century, but she doesn't adapt to the 31st century as well as he has. Convincing Fry to return to the cryogenic chamber, they awaken in a barren wasteland and struggle to make a place for themselves.

programs.title: Parasites Lost
programs.description: When Fry becomes infested with parasitic worms that make him stronger and smarter, he finally finds the perfect way to profess his feelings to Leela. Meanwhile, the rest of the crew goes on a journey into Fry's body to eradicate the worms.

programs.title: Amazon Women in the Mood
programs.description: A double-date for Kif, Amy, Zapp, and Leela ends in disaster when their orbiting restaurant crashes on planet Amazonia. The hulking female inhabitants of the planet take their male captives to the omniscient Femputer, who orders Fry, Zapp, and Kif to death by "snu-snu".

programs.title: Bendless Love
programs.description: Bender's urge to bend prompts Professor Farnsworth to send him on a rehabilitation visit to a steel factory, where he falls in love with a shapely fem-bot named Angleyne. But Bender's old rival Flexo and the intrusion of the Robot Mafia threaten to throw a wrench into the proceedings.

programs.title: The Day the Earth Stood Stupid
programs.description: Earth is invaded by super-intelligent flying brains, who sap the Earth's populace of their intelligence. Leela is taken to Nibbler's home planet Eternia, where the Nibblonians explain that only one human is immune to the brains' powers - Fry.

programs.title: That's Lobstertainment!
programs.description: Dr. Zoidberg reunites with his uncle, silent hologram star Harold Zoid, and the two of them set out to make a movie together. They cast the temperamental Calculon in the lead role, who demands an Oscar for his performance, but the movie doesn't go over well with audiences.

programs.title: The Birdbot of Ice-Catraz
programs.description: A sober Bender crashes a dark matter tanker on Pluto, threatening the penguin reserve nearby. Leela helps out in the clean-up, but when the penguins begin mating out of control, drastic action must be taken to thin the herd.

programs.title: The Luck of the Fryrish
programs.description: After a string of bad luck, Fry ventures into the decaying ruins of Old New York to regain his lucky seven-leaf clover from his childhood, only to find that his brother Yancy Fry had stolen not only the clover, but Fry's identity as well. Fry sets out to exhume his brother's body, but discovers the startling truth about Yancy instead.

programs.title: The Cyber House Rules
programs.description: Leela meets up with her former orphanarium playmate Adlai Atkins, now a plastic surgeon, who offers to grant Leela surgery that will give her two eyes. Meanwhile, Bender adopts twelve orphans in order to collect $1200 in government stipends.

programs.title: Insane in the Mainframe
programs.description: Accused of robbing a bank, Fry and Bender plead insanity and are both sent to a robot insane asylum. While Bender and his buddy Roberto plan an escape, Fry is brainwashed into thinking that he is a robot.

programs.title: Bendin' in the Wind
programs.description: When Bender is paralyzed in a tragic can opener accident, he discovers his musical washboard skills and goes on tour as a member of Beck's folk-rock band, acting as a voice for broken robots everywhere. Fry, Leela, Amy, and Zoidberg tag along in Fry's antique 1960s VW Van.

programs.title: Time Keeps On Slippin'
programs.description: While creating a team of mutants to play the Harlem Globetrotters, the Professor accidentally causes a disruption in time that threatens the existence of the universe. Meanwhile, Fry tries to win an unreceptive Leela's heart.

programs.title: I Dated a Robot
programs.description: Fry discovers the ability to download any celebrity onto a blank robot, and chooses to download Lucy Liu, with whom he falls madly in love. Repulsed by this disgusting display of human/robot love, Leela, Bender, and Zoidberg set out to shut down Nappster.com and put an end to illegal celebrity downloads forever.

programs.title: Roswell That Ends Well
programs.description: A spacetime accident leaves the Planet Express crew stranded in Roswell, New Mexico in the year 1947, where a shattered Bender is mistaken for UFO debris and Zoidberg is captured as an alien specimen. Leela and the professor work to get everybody home, while Fry tries to keep his accident-prone grandfather alive.

programs.title: A Tale of Two Santas
programs.description: A Planet Express mission to Robot Santa's colony on Neptune leaves the murderous robot trapped in the frozen sea, and Bender takes over as Santa, vowing to bring peace and goodwill to Xmas again. But when Bender is mistaken for the real Robot Santa, he is arrested and sentenced to death.

programs.title: Anthology of Interest II
programs.description: When the Professor fine tunes his "What-If" machine, Bender discovers what it would be like if he were human, Fry discovers what it would be like if life were more like a video game, and Leela discovers what it would be like if she found her true home.

programs.title: Love and Rocket
programs.description: As Valentine's Day approaches, Bender's romance with the Planet Express ship puts the crew in jeopardy.

programs.title: Leela's Homeworld
programs.description: Leela finally learns the truth about her parents and her own identity.

programs.title: Where the Buggalo Roam
programs.description: When Amy's parents' ranch is hit by a dust storm that blows away their herd of buggalo, Kif sets out to prove his masculinity by rounding up the herd, only to become entangled with the native Martians.

programs.title: A Pharaoh to Remember
programs.description: Bender fears that nobody will remember him after he dies, and sees his chance for immortality when the crew is enslaved on the planet Osiris 4. Posing as the planet's new pharaoh, Bender orders a humongous statue built in his honor, and quickly goes mad with power.

programs.title: Godfellas
programs.description: Bender is accidentally shot out of the ship's torpedo tube and becomes lost in space. Floating through the ethereal darkness, Bender becomes inhabited with tiny alien life forms, but has trouble playing God to their unyielding prayers.

programs.title: Future Stock
programs.description: With Planet Express in financial trouble, Fry nominates a flashy businessman from the 1980s to replace Professor Farnsworth as CEO of the company.

programs.title: A Leela of Her Own
programs.description: Leela endeavors to become the first female blernsball player, but her lack of depth perception hinders her skills. Nevertheless, she becomes the pitcher for the New New York Mets, purely for her novelty value.

programs.title: 30% Iron Chef
programs.description: Bender, insulted by the reception his terrible cooking receives, runs away and joins a space hobo camp, where he apprentices with a legendary former TV chef. Meanwhile, Dr. Zoidberg accidentally destroys Professor Farnsworth's prized ship-in-a-bottle and frames Fry.

programs.title: Where No Fan Has Gone Before
programs.description: The crew is pitted against the original Star Trek cast to win the devotion of an energy creature.

programs.title: Human Flesh
programs.description: A health inspector's visit coincides with Bob's efforts to bring in customers.

programs.title: Crawl Space
programs.description: A leaky roof causes Bob to get trapped in a wall while Linda's mother visits.

programs.title: Sacred Cow
programs.description: Bob takes to a film maker's cow.

programs.title: Sexy Dance Fighting
programs.description: Tina develops a crush on her martial arts instructor.

programs.title: Hamburger Dinner Theater
programs.description: Linda and the kids stage a murder mystery that doesn't go as planned.

programs.title: Sheesh! Cab, Bob?
programs.description: Tina is desperate to get her first kiss at her 13th birthday party. But after Louise breaks the deep fryer, Bob takes a second job as a late-night cab driver to pay for Tina’s party. Things keep getting worse for Bob when the parents of Tina’s crush refuse to let their son attend the party, and Bob has to do everything in his power to save his daughter’s big day.

programs.title: Bed & Breakfast
programs.description: Louise spies on the Belcher's suspicious house guest.

programs.title: Art Crawl
programs.description: It's Bob vs. the city art council when Linda's sister displays her work at Bob's Burgers.

programs.title: Spaghetti Western and Meatballs
programs.description: Bob and Gene bond over spaghetti western movies, which makes Louise jealous.

programs.title: Burger War
programs.description: When Bob's eccentric landlord, Mr. Fischoeder, pays the family a visit, he informs Bob that his rival across the street, Jimmy Pesto of Jimmy Pesto's Pizzeria, wants to take over Bob's lease so that he can expand his gift shop. With little time and not enough money, the Belcher family must cook up some business or luck to save the restaurant.

programs.title: Weekend at Mort's
programs.description: Bob and his family are forced to spend the weekend at Mort the Mortician's while the restaurant is being de-molded. Linda and Bob double date with Mort and a female mortician he meets online while Tina babysits Gene and Louise in Mort’s crematorium.

programs.title: Lobsterfest
programs.description: After the town's annual Lobsterfest is cancelled by a storm, Bob defiantly opens his doors for a festive celebration. When he wakes the next morning, Bob finds the restaurant in disarray and that the town has spurned him, but Bob won't let that deter him from further involvement in the celebratory weekend.

programs.title: Torpedo
programs.description: Bob's hero, a washed-up baseball player named Torpedo Jones, starts pitching for the local minor league team. Torpedo befriends Bob, but the dark underbelly of minor league baseball threatens to corrupt the Belchers.

programs.title: The Belchies
programs.description: The kids hunt for treasure in an abandoned taffy factory and Bob and Linda must find them before the factory’s scheduled demolition.

programs.title: Bob Day Afternoon
programs.description: A bank robber holds up a bank across the street from Bob’s Burgers. When the robbery goes awry, Bob finds himself at the center of a hostage crisis.

programs.title: Synchronized Swimming
programs.description: The kids con their way out of gym class with a bogus synchronized swimming independent study. Meanwhile, Bob welcomes a new soft serve ice cream machine to the restaurant.

programs.title: Burgerboss
programs.description: Bob becomes obsessed with an old-school burger-flipping video game after Jimmy Pesto gets the high score and writes "BOB SUX" on the leader board.

programs.title: Food Truckin'
programs.description: The Belchers beg Bob to buy a food truck to compete against the ones that are stealing his customers. When the "Lolla-Pa-Foods-A-Festival" comes up, the Belchers bring the truck and the kids decide to cause mischief. Unfortunately, this causes a riot to rise from the other food truckers.

programs.title: Dr. Yap
programs.description: While Bob is medicated, he mistakes Linda's sister, Gayle, for his wife and kisses her. After she falls for him, Bob seeks help from Dr. Yap.

programs.title: Moody Foodie
programs.description: The restaurant receives a negative review from a vicious food critic.

programs.title: Bad Tina
programs.description: Tina befriends a bad girl in a bid to get closer to Jimmy Junior.

programs.title: Beefsquatch
programs.description: Bob appears in a cooking segment on a local news morning program, but Gene steals the show when he crashes the set with a sasquatch mask.

programs.title: Ear-sy Rider
programs.description: A biker gang sets up shop in the restaurant, where they lament the loss of their beloved leader.

programs.title: Full Bars
programs.description: The Belcher kids break with a long standing Halloween tradition, veering away from their usual trick or treat trek in favor of a posh neighborhood that's known for its oversize goodies.

programs.title: Bob Fires the Kids
programs.description: Worried that his kids are not enjoying summer vacation because he's making them work in the restaurant, Bob fires them. But they soon become bored and take jobs as "weed pickers" for a pair of hippie farmers.

programs.title: Mutiny on the Windbreaker
programs.description: Bob does a tour of duty as a private chef on a docked cruise ship and brings along the family to witness his true culinary skills, but the special occasion is scuttled when the kooky captain shanghais the whole family.

programs.title: An Indecent Thanksgiving Proposal
programs.description: Bob's plans for his favorite holiday, Thanksgiving, change when Mr. Fischoeder hires him as a chef, and Linda and the kids to play his family, as he tries to stage a perfect holiday dinner in order to make a former flame jealous.

programs.title: The Deepening
programs.description: Mr. Fischoeder's new pier attraction, a mechanical shark, goes haywire and terrorizes the town, and it falls to Bob and the family to catch it.

programs.title: Tina-rannosaurus Wrecks
programs.description: After Tina accidentally wrecks the car, and gets the whole family involved with a slimy insurance agent, she worries that she’s a “jinx”.

programs.title: The Unbearable Like-Likeness of Gene
programs.description: Gene gets his first girlfriend, but it doesn't take long for the family to realize that she is incredibly annoying and they pressure him to break up with her.

programs.title: Bob Rest Ye Merry Gentle-Mannequins
programs.description: When Bob inherits a storage unit around Christmas, visions of riches dance in the heads of the family, but what they find inside is a squatter who claims he once worked as a mannequin.

programs.title: Mother Daughter Laser Razor
programs.description: Linda worries that her relationship with Louise isn't as good as it should be, so, much to Louise's chagrin, she forces the young lady to participate in a mother-daughter seminar. With mom away, Tina turns to Bob for a lesson in shaving her legs.

programs.title: Nude Beach
programs.description: The new health inspector proves to be a decent fellow, until he blackmails Bob into being allowed to perform his atrocious music at the restaurant, which drives away the customers.

programs.title: Broadcast Wagstaff School News
programs.description: There is a “Mad Pooper” running wild at the Belcher children's middle school and Tina finds herself on a mission to get to the “bottom” of the situation.

programs.title: My Fuzzy Valentine
programs.description: When a heart-shaped pancake simply doesn't cut it, the kids convince Bob to let them skip school in order to help him find a Valentine's Day gift that will "wow" Linda. Meanwhile, in the spirit of the romantic holiday, Linda sets up a speed-dating event at the restaurant that doesn't go exactly as planned.

programs.title: Lindapendent Woman
programs.description: Linda thinks Bob doesn't appreciate her and quits the restaurant to work at a grocery store. In her absence, Bob tries - and fails - to run the place on his own and the kids are stuck in the middle of the marital mayhem. Meanwhile, things get romantic for Tina when she meets her potential soul mate while restocking the milk fridge.

programs.title: O.T.: The Outside Toilet
programs.description: When Gene finds an expensive talking toilet out in the woods, he and his friends decide to protect it as much as they can while an evil toilet hunter is looking for the toilet.

programs.title: Topsy
programs.description: Louise expects to get a charge out of taking down her Thomas Edison-obsessed science teacher when she re-creates one of the famous inventor's experiments that involved electrocuting an elephant.

programs.title: Two for Tina
programs.description: Jimmy Jr. is threatened when Tina starts dating a ballet dancer named Josh and the two boys get into an epic dance-off for her heart.

programs.title: It Snakes a Village
programs.description: The Belcher family road-trips down to Florida to visit Linda's parents who live in a senior home that - to Linda's complete horror - is full of senior swingers! Plus, to keep themselves entertained, Tina, Gene and Louise go on a hunt for a mysterious python that allegedly ate one of the residents' dogs.

programs.title: Family Fracas
programs.description: After the family car breaks down and ruins their plans for a movie night out, the Belchers find themselves competing on the TV game show "Family Fracas!" To the dismay of the program's host, they keep winning and coming back each night...that is until their lucky streak comes to a suspicious end.

programs.title: The Kids Run the Restaurant
programs.description: After Bob cuts his finger and faints at the sight of his own blood, Linda brings him to the hospital and leaves the kids home alone. Not ones to waste a golden opportunity, Tina, Gene and Louise transform the basement of the restaurant into a makeshift casino. But they get more than they gamble for when landlord Mr. Fischoeder stops by and catches them in action.

programs.title: Boyz 4 Now
programs.description: While accompanying Tina to a "Boyz 4 Now" concert, Louise develops a crush on one of the lead singers, Boo Boo - and is in disbelief that she actually likes a boy! Meanwhile, Gene gets creative - and slightly offensive - in a table-setting competition.

programs.title: Carpe Museum
programs.description: Bob chaperones a school trip to the museum and experiences some father-daughter bonding with Louise, while Gene and his gang are on the lookout for exhibits with busts, and not the kind that are sculpted out of stone. Later, on the museum steps, Linda offers her distinctive chanting talents to striking workers.

programs.title: The Unnatural
programs.description: After Gene loses his confidence at his baseball game, Linda decides to sign him up for baseball camp. The only problem? She needs money to pay for it! Meanwhile, Tina discovers her love for espresso and becomes a caffeine addict.

channels.name: Marvel MCU
channels.description: The Marvel Cinematic Universe in release order, from Iron Man onward.

programs.title: Iron Man
programs.description: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

programs.title: The Incredible Hulk
programs.description: Scientist Bruce Banner scours the planet for an antidote to the unbridled force of rage within him: the Hulk. But when the military masterminds who dream of exploiting his powers force him back to civilization, he finds himself coming face to face with a new, deadly foe.

programs.title: Iron Man 2
programs.description: With the world now aware of his dual life as the armored superhero Iron Man, billionaire inventor Tony Stark faces pressure from the government, the press and the public to share his technology with the military. Unwilling to let go of his invention, Stark, with Pepper Potts and James 'Rhodey' Rhodes at his side, must forge new alliances – and confront powerful enemies.

programs.title: Thor
programs.description: Against his father Odin's will, The Mighty Thor - a powerful but arrogant warrior god - recklessly reignites an ancient war. Thor is cast down to Earth and forced to live among humans as punishment. Once here, Thor learns what it takes to be a true hero when the most dangerous villain of his world sends the darkest forces of Asgard to invade Earth.

programs.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
programs.description: During World War II, Steve Rogers is a sickly man from Brooklyn who's transformed into super-soldier Captain America to aid in the war effort. Rogers must stop the Red Skull – Adolf Hitler's ruthless head of weaponry, and the leader of an organization that intends to use a mysterious device of untold powers for world domination.

programs.title: The Avengers
programs.description: When an unexpected enemy emerges and threatens global safety and security, Nick Fury, director of the international peacekeeping agency known as S.H.I.E.L.D., finds himself in need of a team to pull the world back from the brink of disaster. Spanning the globe, a daring recruitment effort begins!

programs.title: Iron Man 3
programs.description: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.

programs.title: Thor: The Dark World
programs.description: Thor fights to restore order across the cosmos… but an ancient race led by the vengeful Malekith returns to plunge the universe back into darkness. Faced with an enemy that even Odin and Asgard cannot withstand, Thor must embark on his most perilous and personal journey yet, one that will reunite him with Jane Foster and force him to sacrifice everything to save us all.

programs.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
programs.description: After the cataclysmic events in New York with The Avengers, Steve Rogers, aka Captain America is living quietly in Washington, D.C. and trying to adjust to the modern world. But when a S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague comes under attack, Steve becomes embroiled in a web of intrigue that threatens to put the world at risk.
